authority.sourceCue: The HATCHERY panel's large tapered honeycomb egg and Queen's Nursery copy, plus the source island's subordinate golden hive architecture.

evidence: isolated actual-mesh orbit evidence under evidence/hatchery-v001-*

requiredFeatures: A single unmistakable tapered royal brood egg is the hero silhouette: weighted base, narrower shoulder, pointed crown, and visible six-sided shell segmentation from every orbit.

The egg is visibly housed in a broad nursery base with an egg-seat collar, centered purple arched nursery door, short entry stairs, and two low brood wings that support rather than compete with the egg.
Honeycomb shell structure uses sparse large structural cells plus medium collar cells over dark or translucent amber recesses; never uniform tiny wallpaper.
A substantial royal crown collar and queen/bee finial seat cleanly on the egg tip with rear continuity and no floating socket.
Warm internal nursery glow and occupied brood-wing windows survive the phone overview while the egg remains the first read.
360 geometry is closed and coherent: no front card, blank rear, intersecting wings, or unsupported crown.
strictRejects: wings wider or taller than the hero egg

capture.gate: Every required category at least 0.85; one correction maximum.
